messages:
maria: heads up — got a prod crash from the Node SDK after the console started serving a different route header shape. Repro locally, leaving details below. @sam can you take a look?

sam: paste stack / header please

maria: here's what came through and the crash:```
Header: x-rd-route-meta: {"quota":"pb-314159", "affinity":"soft", "tags": ["beta"]}

Traceback (Node):
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'split')
    at parseRouteHeader (/usr/src/app/lib/routing.js:82:24)
    at RequestHandler.handle (/usr/src/app/lib/handler.js:47:12)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93:5)
```

ankit: looks like SDK code assumed x-rd-route-meta was always a string like "quota:pb-...;affinity:soft" and did .split on it. Console rollout started sending structured JSON when the new structuredRouteMeta flag was enabled. that's a breaking change for older SDKs.

elena: hmm — we flipped structuredRouteMeta to 100% for internal orgs last night for the new routing telemetry. didn't think older clients would blow up. we should either revert or make SDKs tolerant.

maria: repro steps:```
curl -H 'x-rd-route-meta: {"quota":"pb-314159","affinity":"soft","tags":["beta"]}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
# then call node client with same header flow or integration test
```

sam: proposal: patch Node SDK to accept both formats. Implementation: try JSON.parse(header) first, if that fails, treat as legacy string and parse with existing splitter. Surround with try/catch and emit a telemetry event sdk.header.parse_error with sdk_version + header_sample (hashed) so we can measure impact. ship as hotfix v1.8.4. also add a deprecation notice in the server->clients header contract docs.

ankit: +1. Also add unit tests for both shapes and an array case (some proxies were turning single values into arrays earlier).

elena: I'll add a console compat flag: when compat_mode=true we'll stringify the header value (legacy format) and slowly ramp down structured payloads for orgs with old SDK versions. I'll coordinate with rollout. can we add a dashboard for parse_error per SDK version?

devex-bot: Ticket created: INF-4237 Node SDK header-compatibility. Assigned to @maria and @sam. Priority: P1. ETA: hotfix by EOD. https://issues.redwood/INF-4237

maria: :thumbsup: I'll open the PR with try/catch + tests and the telemetry event. will include migration note in changelog.

sam: happy to review. once merged we can request a quick patch release and ask infra to flip console compat_mode on for affected orgs.

ankit: let's also add a short-lived log metric for parse success vs fallback so we can validate traffic shape before turning off compat_mode.

elena: will create console feature flag and set to 50% for internal first. will post rollout ID here.

maria: thanks all — will keep updates here.
